references.text: Describes the Passover celebration and the command to observe it, which Jesus and his disciples prepare to follow in Matthew 26:19.
Refers to the Passover feast and the regulations associated with its observance, relevant to the preparations Jesus instructs his disciples to make.
Contains commands to celebrate Passover and other festivals, providing context for the actions of the disciples in Matthew 26:19.
Direct context for the verse, where Jesus gives instructions to his disciples on how to prepare for Passover.
Luke's parallel account of the preparations for the Passover meal, showing the disciples' obedience to Jesus' instructions.
Mark's parallel account of how the disciples prepared for Passover according to Jesus' instructions.
